enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +29: Passive: +29 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Sound and Silence: When true power is spoken, weaker beings cannot refute it. Your offensive spells and attacks have a small chance to cause 10d20 Sonic Damage to nearby enemies and Silence them. Each target can negate the Silence on Will save vs DC 90.
Sonic Intensity +20%: +20% Enhancement bonus to critical damage with Sonic spells.
Sonic Lore +22: Passive: Your Sonic spells gain a 22% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Resonance +148: Passive: +148 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spell Power.

Crystal: Crystal weapons are able to overcome the protective damage reduction of many Quori creatures, which can be resistant to other weapons. Spell failure chances for armors and shields made from crystal are also decreased by 10%.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
